description: Use for keyword or fuzzy text (partial names, typos, model plus part words) when you lack an exact part number or slug. Exact part number: get_part. Exact model: get_model_parts. Vague repair need: resolve_request. Matching, in order: a part number (case, dashes, spaces ignored) ranks first; "<model> <type word>" naming one model returns its documented parts (mode model_exact); an ambiguous model plus type word returns mode needs_clarification; a bare type word ("ram") lists parts of that type. Otherwise each word is a case-insensitive substring match on model name/slug/board and part number/name/type/brand, sorted by words matched, with parts fitting the best-matching model first. type keeps parts of exactly that type (case-insensitive), overrides a type word and never filters models. A miss returns mode no_match or did_you_mean (never auto-applied) with fit_status no_documented_fit: no document, not incompatibility. Read-only.

limit.description: Optional cap on each of the models and parts lists, 1 to 50; default 20.

query.description: Required free text (max 200 characters): a model name, an OEM part number, a part type or a mix, e.g. "ThinkPad T490 battery", "01FR025", "7K4PW" or "ram".

type.description: Optional part type, matched exactly but case-insensitively against part types listed by get_coverage, e.g. "Battery", "Screen", "Keyboard", "Power Adapter", "SSD", "Memory".

name: search_parts

fit_status.description: Present when there is no fit or no result: LPF has no OEM document for it. Never means incompatible.

display_name.description: Short human label; not an identifier

title: Search laptop parts
